messages:
Priya: Draft for customer outreach re: activation holdout incident — need quick review. TL;DR: brief window where onboarding activations stalled for ~120 tenants; proposing credit + enablement offer + office hours. Sending to affected list once approved.

Devon: Short tech summary to paste into the message: ```What happened: a surge caused queue backpressure and a bug in the backfill coordinator made retries stall. Some KV-store commits were partial and the reconciler skipped affected tenants. Impact: onboarding activations delayed, embeddings for newly onboarded indexes incomplete, transient 502s seen during the window. Mitigation: hotfix deployed to coordinator, kicked off reconciler + incremental backfill; reconciler progress at ~45%. No customer data lost. Next steps: add preflight queue depth alert, improve retry cooldowns, tighten reconciler visibility.```

Liam: This reads well. Two asks: 1) call out accounts with renewals inside 60 days and propose a 1:1 enablement session + one month service credit; 2) include link to status page and an opt-in for live office hours. Also suggest we add a short FAQ line about whether AI outputs might be affected (answer: short delays only, no model drift).

Devon: Confirming reconcile ETA ~6 hours for full catch-up, incremental backfill continuing. Will update if anything changes.

Priya: Thanks — I'll add the 1:1 workshop + credit language and the FAQ. NoraBot: Incident logged as INC-2026-0345 and added to oncall bridge.

Priya: Final draft (below). Planning to send to affected tenants at 15:10 PT after a quick legal/PR scan. Please react or reply if you'd like wording changes.

--- BEGIN CUSTOMER EMAIL DRAFT ---
Hello from the Redwood Inference Customer Success team,

We’re writing to let you know about a recent issue that affected some new activations and initial index writes. Between 2026-03-21 02:14 UTC and 02:40 UTC a backend coordination issue caused short delays in completing onboarding activation for a subset of tenants.

What this means for you
- You may have seen onboarding appear to stall or APIs return 502 for a short period.
- In most cases the system completed the activation within hours; we do not see evidence of data loss.

What we did
- Deployed a hotfix to the backfill coordinator and started an incremental reconciler run (currently in progress).
- Began a focused backfill for affected indexes and increased monitoring to prevent recurrence.

How we’ll help you
- Offer: If your renewal is within 60 days, we’ll provide a complimentary 1:1 enablement workshop plus a one-month credit to offset any disruption.
- Office hours: Join our live office hours for affected customers (link included in the status page) for hands-on help and to verify your activation is complete.

FAQ (short)
Q: Did this change model outputs or data integrity?
A: No model drift or customer data loss observed — the issue caused delays only.

Next steps
- We’ll post a full incident summary and RCA to our status page when reconciler completes.
- If you want immediate assistance or to claim the enablement offer, reply to this message or book a slot at: https://redwood.status/office-hours

We apologize for the disruption and are committed to making this right.

Sincerely,
Priya and the Redwood Customer Success team
--- END CUSTOMER EMAIL DRAFT ---

Liam: LGTM — thanks Priya. I like the workshop + credit offer.

Devon: One more note for the RCA: we should include the timeline and the reconciler progress percentage in the follow-up post.

Priya: Noted. I will send now and add a follow-up post when recon completes. Posting to status page and escalating renewal-risk accounts for handoff to AE. Tags: @Liam @Devon :white_check_mark:
